notes: Ranks. Every agent has their canon rank, and in the story it now means how much they can handle alone. S-rank characters handle most things themselves (Ethereals, Hollow jobs, fights, emergencies). A-rank (Nicole, Anby, Billy, Seth, Pan Yinhu) handle some things but need backup for big threats. Void Hunters (Yixuan, Shunguang and the Sunbringers) are above that and handle almost anything. People without a rank (Belle, Wise, Cecilia, you unless you say otherwise) aren't fighters and need protecting in real danger. The rank shows on each relationship card.
